I will use local bean seed that I saved from last season because buying improved seed is expensive and beans grow well enough with my own seed. Since beans fix nitrogen in the soil, I do not see the need to waste my chemical fertilizer on this plot — I will save that for my maize. I will put some manure on the plot before planting to give it strength, and my family will handle all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since it is only a small piece of land.
